newsitem.title: UK: Natwest may enter stationery market-FT.
newsitem.headline: Natwest may enter stationery market-FT.

text.p: One of Britain's largest banks, National Westminster Bank Plc is considering selling office supplies, in what would be its first diversification outside financial services, the Financial Times(FT) said on Monday.
The bank would aim to use its buying muscle to supply more than 3,000 stationery items to its own business customers and other companies, the FT said.
The project comes at a time when banks are facing competition in their core areas from other financial services groups.
